description: Embark on a 5-day culinary journey through Tokyo, exploring vibrant street food, mastering Japanese cooking, and indulging in delicious local specialties. This itinerary focuses on immersive food experiences, complemented by comfortable luxury accommodation.

accommodation.amenities: restaurant, spa, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast included

days.title: Arrival and Ginza Street Food Exploration
days.description: Arrive in Tokyo, check into your hotel, and immediately dive into the city's culinary scene with a street food tour in Ginza.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll explore the vibrant streets of Ginza and discover various local food stalls. What to bring: Wear comfortable shoes and bring an appetite. What to eat: Expect to sample a wide array of Japanese street food specialties. Good to know: This tour is an excellent introduction to Tokyo's diverse culinary landscape.

days.title: Morning Cooking Class and Afternoon Culture
days.description: Learn to cook traditional Japanese dishes in the morning, then immerse yourself in Tokyo's rich history and culture with a walking tour.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll learn to prepare authentic Japanese dishes under the guidance of a local chef. What to bring: An eagerness to learn and perhaps a notebook for recipes. What to eat: You'll enjoy the delicious meal you've prepared during the class. Good to know: This hands-on experience offers insight into Japanese culinary traditions.

What you'll see: You'll discover historical landmarks and cultural sites in Tokyo. What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and a camera are recommended. What to eat: While not a food tour, you might find opportunities for snacks along the way. Good to know: This tour provides a great overview of Tokyo's past and present.

days.title: Shibuya Food & Night Market Experience
days.description: Spend the day exploring Shibuya, culminating in an evening tapas crawl through its bustling night market.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll learn to prepare traditional Japanese dishes with a local chef. What to bring: Your enthusiasm for cooking and an empty stomach. What to eat: You'll enjoy the meal you've cooked during the class. Good to know: This afternoon class is perfect for those who prefer a later start to their culinary learning.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Night Market & Tapas Crawl — Evening Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll experience the lively atmosphere of a Tokyo night market and various tapas bars. What to bring: An open mind for new flavors and comfortable walking shoes. What to eat: A variety of small dishes and local snacks will be sampled. Good to know: This is a great way to experience Tokyo's nightlife and diverse food scene.

days.title: Shinjuku Street Food and Relaxation
days.description: Discover the street food of Shinjuku in the morning, followed by a relaxing wellness and spa experience in the afternoon.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Street Food Walking Tour — Premium Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll explore the bustling streets of Shinjuku and taste various local street foods. What to bring: Your appetite and comfortable walking shoes. What to eat: A selection of premium street food items will be offered. Good to know: This tour offers a deeper dive into Shinjuku's culinary offerings.

What you'll see: You'll enjoy a relaxing half-day at a wellness and spa facility. What to bring: Swimwear and a change of clothes. What to eat: Light refreshments may be available at the spa. Good to know: This is a perfect opportunity to unwind and rejuvenate after days of exploring.

days.title: Departure from Tokyo
days.description: Enjoy a final Japanese breakfast before heading to the airport for your departure.
